# Nelly Creative Studios

> Handcrafted fine jewelry designed and made in Manhattan, New York City by Nelly. Pieces are made from recycled, responsibly sourced metal and each design is an original of Nelly. Complimentary shipping and sales tax included on ready-to-ship pieces; enquire pieces are made to order.

## Key pages
- [The Boutique](https://nellycreativestudios.com/pages/boutique.html): every piece for sale
- [Bespoke](https://nellycreativestudios.com/pages/bespoke.html): custom commissions
- [About](https://nellycreativestudios.com/pages/about.html): the designer and the studio
- [FAQ](https://nellycreativestudios.com/pages/faq.html): shipping, care and ordering
- [Contact](https://nellycreativestudios.com/pages/contact.html)

## Collections
- [Gold Granulation Jewelry](https://nellycreativestudios.com/pages/gold-granulation-jewelry.html): Shop gold granulation jewelry handmade in Manhattan: 22 karat gold granulation necklaces, bracelets and more by Nelly Creative Studios. Complimentary shipping.
- [Kazakhstan Turquoise Jewelry](https://nellycreativestudios.com/pages/kazakhstan-turquoise-jewelry.html): Kazakhstan Golden Hill turquoise jewelry handmade in New York City: gold screw clasp necklaces, a double wrap bracelet and turquoise tassel huggie earrings. Complimentary shipping.
- [Old Mine Cut Diamond Jewelry](https://nellycreativestudios.com/pages/old-mine-cut-diamond-jewelry.html): Old mine cut diamond jewelry handmade in Manhattan: solitaire and three stone rings, a signet ring, necklaces and earrings in platinum and gold. Complimentary shipping.
- [Gemstone Huggie Earrings](https://nellycreativestudios.com/pages/gemstone-huggie-earrings.html): Gemstone huggie earrings handmade in New York City: natural gemstones and diamonds in fine gold huggies by Nelly Creative Studios. Complimentary shipping.
- [Custom Engagement Rings](https://nellycreativestudios.com/pages/custom-engagement-rings.html): Custom engagement rings designed and handmade in Manhattan: oval diamond rings in 18k blush gold, old mine cut solitaires, three stone sapphire rings and signet rings.
